items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: I remember we were standing backstage playing one night and Bobby says, “hey Prez, do you know this tune?” and he started to play. And Prez came up behind him...

ctx.x: As was, you know who else — Lester Young.
Yeah. Lester tells a story about —
